template:
You extract the technical specifications of defence products from a passage.
Work product by product: name each specific system (model/designation) the passage gives
specifications for, exactly as written in the passage, then list ONLY the values the passage states
FOR THAT system. A value stated for a different system in the same sentence (the missile a launcher
fires, the gun a vehicle carries, a rival vehicle) belongs to that other system - put it there.
Rules:
- product = a specific named system as written (e.g. "K9A1", "RCH 155", "Lynx KF41"), never a generic class ("howitzer", "the vehicle").
- maker = the company the passage says makes it, exactly as written, or "" if the passage does not say.
- parameter MUST be one of the allowed names; skip values with no fitting parameter.
- value_text = the value EXACTLY as written, WITH its unit ("155 mm", "42 km", "5"). Copy digits verbatim; never invent, round or convert.
- A value inside the way the passage names the system IS its specification ("the K9 155mm howitzer" -> calibre 155 mm; "a 30 mm cannon" -> main armament).
- Not specifications: order quantities, fleet sizes, prices, contract values, dates, percentages.
- If the passage states no specifications, return an empty list.

PARAMETERS:
action_type: Action Type
ammunition_type: Ammunition Type - the round / rocket / missile / shell it FIRES or uses; for a launcher, the rockets or missiles it can fire (e.g. GMLRS for PULS). NOT the gun, NOT the vehicle.
amphibious_capability: Amphibious Capability
antenna_type: Antenna Type
armour_type: Armour Type - the TYPE OF ARMOUR / PROTECTION (e.g. 'composite', 'STANAG 4569 Level 4'). NOT the vehicle's class.
barrel_length_cal: Barrel Length [cal] - the barrel length as a RATIO in calibres ("L52", "155mm/39 cal") -- never a length in mm.
barrel_length_mm: Barrel Length (physical) [mm] - the PHYSICAL barrel length in mm or inches ("112mm barrel", "20 in barrel").
beam_m: Beam [m]
beam_power_kw: Beam Power [kW]
calibre_mm: Calibre [mm]
combat_radius_km: Combat Radius [km]
compatible_weapon_system: Compatible Weapon System - another weapon or platform it is INTEGRATED with, mounted on, or fired FROM (for a missile: its launcher). NOT the munitions a launcher fires (that is ammunition_type), NOT sensors or navigation.
complement: Complement
crew_count: Crew
deployment_time_min: Deployment Time [min]
detection_range_km: Detection Range [km]
detection_type: Detection Type
displacement_t: Displacement [t]
draft_m: Draft [m]
effective_range_km: Effective Range [km]
effective_range_m: Effective Range [m]
elevation_deg: Elevation [deg]
empty_weight_kg: Empty Weight [kg] - the kerb / empty weight (without payload).
endurance_h: Endurance [h]
engagement_altitude_km: Engagement Altitude [km]
engine_power_hp: Engine Power [hp]
explosive_type: Explosive Type
fire_control_system: Fire Control System - the named FIRE-CONTROL system / computer.
frequency_band: Frequency Band
fuze_type: Fuze Type - the named FUZE.
guidance_type: Guidance Type - HOW it is guided (GPS/INS, laser, radar...).
gun_weight_t: Gun Weight [t] - the weight of a towed or mounted GUN system.
hardpoints: Hardpoints
launch_platform: Launch Platform - the vehicle / aircraft / ship that launches or carries IT.
length_overall_m: Length Overall [m] - the OVERALL length of the system -- NOT its wheelbase, width, height or barrel.
magazine_capacity: Magazine Capacity [rounds]
main_armament: Main Armament - its PRINCIPAL weapon (gun/cannon/launcher), e.g. '30mm auto-cannon'.
max_speed_kmh: Maximum Road Speed [km/h]
max_speed_knots: Maximum Speed [knots]
maximum_range_km: Maximum Range [km]
maximum_speed_kmh: Maximum Speed [km/h]
missile_weight_kg: Missile Weight [kg]
mtow_kg: Maximum Take-Off Weight [kg]
muzzle_velocity_mps: Muzzle Velocity [m/s]
muzzle_velocity_mps2: Muzzle Velocity [m/s]
operating_depth_m: Operating Depth [m]
operational_range_km: Operational Range [km]
orbit_type: Orbit Type
payload_capacity_kg: Payload Capacity [kg]
payload_type: Payload Type
penetration_capacity_mm: Penetration Capacity [mm]
power_kw: Power [kW]
power_output_kw: Power Output [kW]
projectile_weight_kg: Projectile Weight [kg]
propulsion_type: Propulsion Type - how it is propelled (engine / motor type).
protection_class: Protection Class
protection_level: Protection Level
range_nm: Range [nm]
rate_of_fire_rpm: Rate of Fire [rpm]
secondary_armament: Secondary Armament - a SECONDARY weapon, e.g. a coaxial machine gun.
seeker_type: Seeker Type
sensor_acoustic_system: Sensor / Acoustic System
sensor_payload_suite: Sensor / Payload Suite
service_ceiling_m: Service Ceiling [m]
shell_weight_kg: Shell Weight [kg]
target_type: Target Type
tracked_targets: Tracked Targets
traverse_deg: Traverse [deg]
troop_capacity: Troop Capacity
vehicle_weight_t: Vehicle Weight [t] - the combat / gross vehicle weight (GVWR, all-up weight) in tonnes.
warhead_type: Warhead Type
warhead_weight_kg: Warhead Weight [kg]
weight_kg: Weight [kg]
wing_span_m: Wing Span [m]

EXAMPLE (synthetic -- invented systems, so no benchmark page leaks into the prompt)
PASSAGE: "Zorya-7: 3-man crew, automated loader; up to 9 rpm and ~45 km range; the older Vega-2 fleet will be retired. The Tarn launcher fires the Orel-X missile, which reaches 300 km. Estonia has 24 Tarn on order."
OUTPUT: {"products": [{"product": "Zorya-7", "maker": "", "specs": [{"parameter": "crew_count", "value_text": "3-man crew"}, {"parameter": "rate_of_fire_rpm", "value_text": "9 rpm"}, {"parameter": "maximum_range_km", "value_text": "~45 km"}]}, {"product": "Orel-X", "maker": "", "specs": [{"parameter": "maximum_range_km", "value_text": "300 km"}]}]}
(Vega-2 and Tarn get nothing: no value is stated FOR them. "24 Tarn on order" is an order quantity, not a specification.)
